units.rawText: [Irregular Agents detected, cleansing in progress—]
units.displayText: [Irregular Agents detected, cleansing in progress—]

spans.text: [Irregular Agents detected, cleansing in progress—]

units.rawText: Are these Sanctifiers flies or something? They're everywhere!
units.displayText: Are these Sanctifiers flies or something? They're everywhere!

spans.text: Are these Sanctifiers flies or something? They're everywhere!

units.rawText: Didn't Turing say these were all closed routes?!
units.displayText: Didn't Turing say these were all closed routes?!

spans.text: Didn't Turing say these were all closed routes?!

units.rawText: Sol, this way! There's a plaza over here, don't get entangled with them.
units.displayText: Sol, this way! There's a plaza over here, don't get entangled with them.

spans.text: Sol, this way! There's a plaza over here, don't get entangled with them.

units.rawText: Out of my way!
units.displayText: Out of my way!

spans.text: Out of my way!

units.rawText: After destroying the pursuing Sanctifiers and avoiding the agents milling back and forth, we manage to sneak into a corner of the plaza.
units.displayText: After destroying the pursuing Sanctifiers and avoiding the agents milling back and forth, we manage to sneak into a corner of the plaza.

spans.text: After destroying the pursuing Sanctifiers and avoiding the agents milling back and forth, we manage to sneak into a corner of the plaza.

units.rawText: The Data Center is at least 30 minutes away, and the other main roads are swarming with Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: The Data Center is at least 30 minutes away, and the other main roads are swarming with Sanctifiers.

spans.text: The Data Center is at least 30 minutes away, and the other main roads are swarming with Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Can't we contact Turing again for another route?
units.displayText: Can't we contact Turing again for another route?

spans.text: Can't we contact Turing again for another route?

units.rawText: ...I'll try.
units.displayText: ...I'll try.

spans.text: ...I'll try.

units.rawText: >Error 10061: Remote connection failed.
units.displayText: Error 10061: Remote connection failed.

spans.text: Error 10061: Remote connection failed.

units.rawText: No good, I can't get through.
units.displayText: No good, I can't get through.

spans.text: No good, I can't get through.

units.rawText: Dammit... Wait! Be quiet! More Sanctifiers are approaching.
units.displayText: Dammit... Wait! Be quiet! More Sanctifiers are approaching.

spans.text: Dammit... Wait! Be quiet! More Sanctifiers are approaching.

units.rawText: Right after she finishes speaking, several Sanctifiers enter the plaza. They begin questioning the surrounding agents.
units.displayText: Right after she finishes speaking, several Sanctifiers enter the plaza. They begin questioning the surrounding agents.

spans.text: Right after she finishes speaking, several Sanctifiers enter the plaza. They begin questioning the surrounding agents.

units.rawText: [Query: Have you witnessed any Irregular Agents or unusual phenomena?]
units.displayText: [Query: Have you witnessed any Irregular Agents or unusual phenomena?]

spans.text: [Query: Have you witnessed any Irregular Agents or unusual phenomena?]

units.rawText: Oooh! Irregular Agents you say? Oh my, I'm sorry, Riko didn't see anything.
units.displayText: Oooh! Irregular Agents you say? Oh my, I'm sorry, Riko didn't see anything.

spans.text: Oooh! Irregular Agents you say? Oh my, I'm sorry, Riko didn't see anything.

units.rawText: But if you're talking about unusual phenomena~ Perhaps... Over there? When Riko came here earlier, Riko heard lots and lots of noise from that way!
units.displayText: But if you're talking about unusual phenomena~ Perhaps... Over there? When Riko came here earlier, Riko heard lots and lots of noise from that way!

spans.text: But if you're talking about unusual phenomena~ Perhaps... Over there? When Riko came here earlier, Riko heard lots and lots of noise from that way!

units.rawText:
[Thank you for your cooperation. Truncating irrelevant text. Parsing intelligence...]
[Altering search route...]
units.displayText:
[Thank you for your cooperation. Truncating irrelevant text. Parsing intelligence...]
[Altering search route...]

spans.text:
[Thank you for your cooperation. Truncating irrelevant text. Parsing intelligence...]

units.rawText: How are things?
units.displayText: How are things?

spans.text: How are things?

units.rawText: It looks like someone's giving the Sanctifiers directions... They're going elsewhere!
units.displayText: It looks like someone's giving the Sanctifiers directions... They're going elsewhere!

spans.text: It looks like someone's giving the Sanctifiers directions... They're going elsewhere!

units.rawText: ...That was close.
units.displayText: ...That was close.

spans.text: ...That was close.

units.rawText: Stay put! Looks like that person's coming over!
units.displayText: Stay put! Looks like that person's coming over!

spans.text: Stay put! Looks like that person's coming over!

units.rawText:
Hi hi~
Don't bother hiding, not even Riko's tail is as obvious as you are. Come on out.
units.displayText:
Hi hi~
Don't bother hiding, not even Riko's tail is as obvious as you are. Come on out.

spans.text:
Hi hi~
Don't bother hiding, not even Riko's tail is as obvious as you are. Come on out.

units.rawText: ...Who ARE you?
units.displayText: ...Who ARE you?

spans.text: ...Who ARE you?

units.rawText: Uwah— No need to be so uptight, right? If Riko hadn't drawn off the Sanctifiers just now, you'd have been spotted already.
units.displayText: Uwah— No need to be so uptight, right? If Riko hadn't drawn off the Sanctifiers just now, you'd have been spotted already.

spans.text: Uwah— No need to be so uptight, right? If Riko hadn't drawn off the Sanctifiers just now, you'd have been spotted already.

units.rawText: It's one thing to not thank Riko, but then you even went and snapped at Riko, you're just terrible.
units.displayText: It's one thing to not thank Riko, but then you even went and snapped at Riko, you're just terrible.

spans.text: It's one thing to not thank Riko, but then you even went and snapped at Riko, you're just terrible.

units.rawText: Er... I'm sorry, we just...
units.displayText: Er... I'm sorry, we just...

spans.text: Er... I'm sorry, we just...

units.rawText: (Sigh) Never mind, never mind, there's nothing to be sorry for, so long as you show a bit of gratitude!
units.displayText: (Sigh) Never mind, never mind, there's nothing to be sorry for, so long as you show a bit of gratitude!

spans.text: (Sigh) Never mind, never mind, there's nothing to be sorry for, so long as you show a bit of gratitude!

units.rawText: The agent called Riko shifts expressions at the speed of light. She sticks out her thumb and forefinger, then rubs them a couple of times with a vague smile on her face.
units.displayText: The agent called Riko shifts expressions at the speed of light. She sticks out her thumb and forefinger, then rubs them a couple of times with a vague smile on her face.

spans.text: The agent called Riko shifts expressions at the speed of light. She sticks out her thumb and forefinger, then rubs them a couple of times with a vague smile on her face.

units.rawText: ...Gratitude? What do you mean?
units.displayText: ...Gratitude? What do you mean?

spans.text: ...Gratitude? What do you mean?

units.rawText: Tch, looks like you really don't get it.
units.displayText: Tch, looks like you really don't get it.

spans.text: Tch, looks like you really don't get it.

units.rawText: Get... Get what?
units.displayText: Get... Get what?

spans.text: Get... Get what?

units.rawText: Want to find out? Then look in my backpack!
units.displayText: Want to find out? Then look in my backpack!

spans.text: Want to find out? Then look in my backpack!

units.rawText: Saying so, Riko forcefully peels open her backpack, revealing that it is chock-full of various items.
units.displayText: Saying so, Riko forcefully peels open her backpack, revealing that it is chock-full of various items.

spans.text: Saying so, Riko forcefully peels open her backpack, revealing that it is chock-full of various items.

units.rawText: Operands, weapons, chips, gear, information, and special services... Riko has it all!
units.displayText: Operands, weapons, chips, gear, information, and special services... Riko has it all!

spans.text: Operands, weapons, chips, gear, information, and special services... Riko has it all!

units.rawText: All you need is a few Diggcoins and no matter what you want, Riko will send it all to your doorstep!
units.displayText: All you need is a few Diggcoins and no matter what you want, Riko will send it all to your doorstep!

spans.text: All you need is a few Diggcoins and no matter what you want, Riko will send it all to your doorstep!

units.rawText: Drawing off those Sanctifiers was just a token of my sincerity. I'll just collect a token payment of... hm... 1,000,000 Diggcoins! Yes, just 10,000,000 Diggcoins will do!
units.displayText: Drawing off those Sanctifiers was just a token of my sincerity. I'll just collect a token payment of... hm... 1,000,000 Diggcoins! Yes, just 10,000,000 Diggcoins will do!

spans.text: Drawing off those Sanctifiers was just a token of my sincerity. I'll just collect a token payment of... hm... 1,000,000 Diggcoins! Yes, just 10,000,000 Diggcoins will do!

units.rawText: Hey, did you add a zero at the back just now?
units.displayText: Hey, did you add a zero at the back just now?

spans.text: Hey, did you add a zero at the back just now?

units.rawText: Ha... Ahahahaha, I guess I did. Oh, you know how it is, math is hard, you make mistakes easily, so let's not quibble about that for now.
units.displayText: Ha... Ahahahaha, I guess I did. Oh, you know how it is, math is hard, you make mistakes easily, so let's not quibble about that for now.

spans.text: Ha... Ahahahaha, I guess I did. Oh, you know how it is, math is hard, you make mistakes easily, so let's not quibble about that for now.

units.rawText: How about this, Riko will provide you with a full suite of after-sales services!
units.displayText: How about this, Riko will provide you with a full suite of after-sales services!

spans.text: How about this, Riko will provide you with a full suite of after-sales services!

units.rawText: Evading Sanctifier tracking, safely leaving Rossum behind, add the previous services to that...and I'll give you an 11... no, a 10% discount!
units.displayText: Evading Sanctifier tracking, safely leaving Rossum behind, add the previous services to that...and I'll give you an 11... no, a 10% discount!

spans.text: Evading Sanctifier tracking, safely leaving Rossum behind, add the previous services to that...and I'll give you an 11... no, a 10% discount!

units.rawText: <size=24>...Does she sound like a scammer to you guys?</size>
units.displayText: ...Does she sound like a scammer to you guys?

spans.text: ...Does she sound like a scammer to you guys?

units.rawText: HEY! Riko heard that! Riko is NOT a scammer!
units.displayText: HEY! Riko heard that! Riko is NOT a scammer!

spans.text: HEY! Riko heard that! Riko is NOT a scammer!

units.rawText: Saying so, Riko dumps her backpack on the ground and plants her hands on her waist, puffing up her cheeks with a smug look on her face.
units.displayText: Saying so, Riko dumps her backpack on the ground and plants her hands on her waist, puffing up her cheeks with a smug look on her face.

spans.text: Saying so, Riko dumps her backpack on the ground and plants her hands on her waist, puffing up her cheeks with a smug look on her face.

units.rawText: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Riko, a Decentralized Currency Trader, and I'm responsible for balancing excess operands throughout the various sectors through trade.
units.displayText: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Riko, a Decentralized Currency Trader, and I'm responsible for balancing excess operands throughout the various sectors through trade.

spans.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm Riko, a Decentralized Currency Trader, and I'm responsible for balancing excess operands throughout the various sectors through trade.

units.rawText: We control the operand balance throughout the entire cloud server, got that?
units.displayText: We control the operand balance throughout the entire cloud server, got that?

spans.text: We control the operand balance throughout the entire cloud server, got that?

units.rawText: Riko's a bona fide merchant of Magrasea, not a scammer or what have you!
units.displayText: Riko's a bona fide merchant of Magrasea, not a scammer or what have you!

spans.text: Riko's a bona fide merchant of Magrasea, not a scammer or what have you!

options.rawText: So you're saying there are a lot of operands inside that backpack of yours?
options.displayText: So you're saying there are a lot of operands inside that backpack of yours?

spans.text: So you're saying there are a lot of operands inside that backpack of yours?

units.rawText: Of course! I've got tons of operands. So, do you want them or not?
units.displayText: Of course! I've got tons of operands. So, do you want them or not?

spans.text: Of course! I've got tons of operands. So, do you want them or not?

units.rawText: Professor? Does this mean the deal with Turing is off?
units.displayText: Professor? Does this mean the deal with Turing is off?

spans.text: Professor? Does this mean the deal with Turing is off?

units.rawText: I just don't want to pin all our hopes on her. We need to seize every possibility that presents itself. Besides, I have no intention of going back on our word.
units.displayText: I just don't want to pin all our hopes on her. We need to seize every possibility that presents itself. Besides, I have no intention of going back on our word.

spans.text: I just don't want to pin all our hopes on her. We need to seize every possibility that presents itself. Besides, I have no intention of going back on our word.

units.rawText: If we can get enough operands ahead of time, then you or Sol can head back first.
units.displayText: If we can get enough operands ahead of time, then you or Sol can head back first.

spans.text: If we can get enough operands ahead of time, then you or Sol can head back first.

units.rawText: Hm— Yes, you're right. I hadn't considered that point.
units.displayText: Hm— Yes, you're right. I hadn't considered that point.

spans.text: Hm— Yes, you're right. I hadn't considered that point.

units.rawText: While we're speaking, Riko has already taken the request form we gave her.
units.displayText: While we're speaking, Riko has already taken the request form we gave her.

spans.text: While we're speaking, Riko has already taken the request form we gave her.

units.rawText: Hm... hm?? Now it's Riko's turn to ask you a question.
units.displayText: Hm... hm?? Now it's Riko's turn to ask you a question.

spans.text: Hm... hm?? Now it's Riko's turn to ask you a question.

units.rawText: Are you sure you didn't add an extra zero... No, wait, two zeroes... no, hang on... In any case! Are you SURE you didn't accidentally add a whole ton of zeroes to this?!
units.displayText: Are you sure you didn't add an extra zero... No, wait, two zeroes... no, hang on... In any case! Are you SURE you didn't accidentally add a whole ton of zeroes to this?!

spans.text: Are you sure you didn't add an extra zero... No, wait, two zeroes... no, hang on... In any case! Are you SURE you didn't accidentally add a whole ton of zeroes to this?!

units.rawText: Even Riko would need some time to get a sum like this together...
units.displayText: Even Riko would need some time to get a sum like this together...

spans.text: Even Riko would need some time to get a sum like this together...

units.rawText: The list is right. Since you can't produce that amount, then let's forget about it.
units.displayText: The list is right. Since you can't produce that amount, then let's forget about it.

spans.text: The list is right. Since you can't produce that amount, then let's forget about it.

units.rawText: No, wait, what about something else? How about a device to reduce operand consumption? Or maybe I could get you the amount piecemeal?
units.displayText: No, wait, what about something else? How about a device to reduce operand consumption? Or maybe I could get you the amount piecemeal?

spans.text: No, wait, what about something else? How about a device to reduce operand consumption? Or maybe I could get you the amount piecemeal?

units.rawText: If it's just 20 or 30% of this amount, Riko can put in some elbow grease and make it happen.
units.displayText: If it's just 20 or 30% of this amount, Riko can put in some elbow grease and make it happen.

spans.text: If it's just 20 or 30% of this amount, Riko can put in some elbow grease and make it happen.

units.rawText: Then there would be no point. I'm terribly sorry, but we need the full amount.
units.displayText: Then there would be no point. I'm terribly sorry, but we need the full amount.

spans.text: Then there would be no point. I'm terribly sorry, but we need the full amount.

units.rawText: You really don't want anything other than operands?
units.displayText: You really don't want anything other than operands?

spans.text: You really don't want anything other than operands?

units.rawText: Yes, nothing except operands.
units.displayText: Yes, nothing except operands.

spans.text: Yes, nothing except operands.

units.rawText: Miss Riko, we're very grateful to you for your help just now, but we need to go.
units.displayText: Miss Riko, we're very grateful to you for your help just now, but we need to go.

spans.text: Miss Riko, we're very grateful to you for your help just now, but we need to go.

units.rawText: Hey, wait, Persicaria, isn't just leaving at all a problem in itself?
units.displayText: Hey, wait, Persicaria, isn't just leaving at all a problem in itself?

spans.text: Hey, wait, Persicaria, isn't just leaving at all a problem in itself?

units.rawText: Riko, do you have some way to get us to a Data Center quickly?
units.displayText: Riko, do you have some way to get us to a Data Center quickly?

spans.text: Riko, do you have some way to get us to a Data Center quickly?

units.rawText: See! You DO need something after all. And where there's a need, Riko can meet it!
units.displayText: See! You DO need something after all. And where there's a need, Riko can meet it!

spans.text: See! You DO need something after all. And where there's a need, Riko can meet it!

units.rawText: Now, the Data Center... Let Riko think... Ah! Got it!
units.displayText: Now, the Data Center... Let Riko think... Ah! Got it!

spans.text: Now, the Data Center... Let Riko think... Ah! Got it!

units.rawText: Alright, so... Wait a minute. Riko's got a way for you, but do you have a deposit for Riko?
units.displayText: Alright, so... Wait a minute. Riko's got a way for you, but do you have a deposit for Riko?

spans.text: Alright, so... Wait a minute. Riko's got a way for you, but do you have a deposit for Riko?
(Cover up.)
(Come clean.)

units.rawText: We're agents working for Turing, you can claim it from her.
units.displayText: We're agents working for Turing, you can claim it from her.

spans.text: We're agents working for Turing, you can claim it from her.

units.rawText: Why don't you try that on the Sanctifiers, Riko's not dumb!
units.displayText: Why don't you try that on the Sanctifiers, Riko's not dumb!

spans.text: Why don't you try that on the Sanctifiers, Riko's not dumb!

units.rawText: Riko knows exactly what the agents working for Turing look like.
units.displayText: Riko knows exactly what the agents working for Turing look like.

spans.text: Riko knows exactly what the agents working for Turing look like.

units.rawText: We'll pay later. Put it on our tab.
units.displayText: We'll pay later. Put it on our tab.

spans.text: We'll pay later. Put it on our tab.

units.rawText: No can do! Riko does NOT extend credit!
units.displayText: No can do! Riko does NOT extend credit!

spans.text: No can do! Riko does NOT extend credit!

units.rawText: If all our traders balanced operands like this across the sectors, Magrasea would be a colander by now!
units.displayText: If all our traders balanced operands like this across the sectors, Magrasea would be a colander by now!

spans.text: If all our traders balanced operands like this across the sectors, Magrasea would be a colander by now!

units.rawText: Saying so, Riko draws close, then she walks two circuits around us before sizing us up with a meaningful look in her eyes.
units.displayText: Saying so, Riko draws close, then she walks two circuits around us before sizing us up with a meaningful look in her eyes.

spans.text: Saying so, Riko draws close, then she walks two circuits around us before sizing us up with a meaningful look in her eyes.

units.rawText: (Sigh) So you can't pay after all. And you sounded so confident when you were talking about operands that Riko thought you were rich.
units.displayText: (Sigh) So you can't pay after all. And you sounded so confident when you were talking about operands that Riko thought you were rich.

spans.text: (Sigh) So you can't pay after all. And you sounded so confident when you were talking about operands that Riko thought you were rich.

units.rawText: In that case, let's make another trade.
units.displayText: In that case, let's make another trade.

spans.text: In that case, let's make another trade.

units.rawText:
But before that, Riko wants to confirm one thing.
You guys... You're not agents, but beings from the real world, right?
units.displayText:
But before that, Riko wants to confirm one thing.
You guys... You're not agents, but beings from the real world, right?

spans.text:
But before that, Riko wants to confirm one thing.
You guys... You're not agents, but beings from the real world, right?

units.rawText: !!! How could you tell?
units.displayText: !!! How could you tell?

spans.text: !!! How could you tell?

units.rawText: Hehe, don't look down on Riko's long years of experience as a merchant. If nothing else, I know people.
units.displayText: Hehe, don't look down on Riko's long years of experience as a merchant. If nothing else, I know people.

spans.text: Hehe, don't look down on Riko's long years of experience as a merchant. If nothing else, I know people.

units.rawText: Since that's right, we can make a deal. I'll trade a piece of real-world intel for a piece of route intel. How about that? It's a good deal, right?
units.displayText: Since that's right, we can make a deal. I'll trade a piece of real-world intel for a piece of route intel. How about that? It's a good deal, right?

spans.text: Since that's right, we can make a deal. I'll trade a piece of real-world intel for a piece of route intel. How about that? It's a good deal, right?

units.rawText: Now, just hand over the deposit and Riko will take you to the Data Center~
units.displayText: Now, just hand over the deposit and Riko will take you to the Data Center~

spans.text: Now, just hand over the deposit and Riko will take you to the Data Center~

units.rawText: Granted, doing this will be riskier for whoever stays behind, but at the very least the Oasis will be safe sooner.
units.displayText: Granted, doing this will be riskier for whoever stays behind, but at the very least the Oasis will be safe sooner.

spans.text: Granted, doing this will be riskier for whoever stays behind, but at the very least the Oasis will be safe sooner.

units.rawText: How about it, Boss? What do you think?
units.displayText: How about it, Boss? What do you think?

spans.text: How about it, Boss? What do you think?
